<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g fill="#323232" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <text x="20" y="21" font-size="13" font-weight="500">9:41</text>
    <rect x="337" y="12" width="3" height="8" fill="#323232"/>
    <rect x="342" y="10" width="3" height="10" fill="#323232"/>
    <rect x="347" y="8" width="3" height="12" fill="#323232"/>
    <rect x="352" y="6" width="3" height="14" fill="#323232"/>
    <circle cx="325" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="17" x2="331" y2="20" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="8" width="20" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="10" width="14" height="9" rx="1.5" fill="#323232"/>
    <rect x="383" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>
  </g>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="63" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,64 20,72 28,80" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="72" x2="38" y2="72" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <text x="52" y="70" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Search flights</text>
    <circle cx="355" cy="70" r="17" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="65" r="4" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <ellipse cx="355" cy="75" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#7A1851"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="20" y1="94" x2="370" y2="94" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- trip switch -->
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <rect x="20" y="111" width="350" height="43" rx="21" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <rect x="22" y="113" width="168" height="39" rx="19" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="106" y="138" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Round trip</text>
    <text x="280" y="138" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">One way</text>
  </g>

  <!-- search panel shadow -->
  <rect x="19" y="176" width="352" height="375" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="18" y="173" width="352" height="375" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- route header -->
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <text x="38" y="202" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">ROUTE</text>
    <circle cx="349" cy="198" r="17" fill="#FFF1F1"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="198" x2="356" y2="198" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="352,194 356,198 352,202" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="346,202 342,198 346,194" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="36" y="218" width="316" height="64" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="239" r="5" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <line x1="58" y1="245" x2="58" y2="260" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="77" y="237" font-size="11" fill="#949499">FROM</text>
    <text x="77" y="260" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Jakarta</text>
    <text x="307" y="260" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="#5F5E65">CGK</text>

    <rect x="36" y="289" width="316" height="64" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="310" r="5" fill="#DB6186"/>
    <polyline points="53,317 58,324 63,317" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="77" y="308" font-size="11" fill="#949499">TO</text>
    <text x="77" y="331" font-size="17" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Bali</text>
    <text x="307" y="331" text-anchor="end" font-size="12" fill="#5F5E65">DPS</text>
  </g>

  <!-- dates -->
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <text x="36" y="379" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">TRAVEL DATES</text>
    <rect x="36" y="391" width="151" height="69" rx="10" fill="#FFF7F7" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="201" y="391" width="151" height="69" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="51" y="408" width="15" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="51" y1="413" x2="66" y2="413" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="405" x2="55" y2="411" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="405" x2="62" y2="411" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="76" y="414" font-size="11" fill="#949499">DEPARTURE</text>
    <text x="51" y="444" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">18 Aug 2026</text>

    <rect x="216" y="408" width="15" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="413" x2="231" y2="413" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="405" x2="220" y2="411" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="227" y1="405" x2="227" y2="411" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="241" y="414" font-size="11" fill="#949499">RETURN</text>
    <text x="216" y="444" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">25 Aug 2026</text>
  </g>

  <!-- passenger and class -->
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <text x="36" y="487" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">PASSENGERS & CLASS</text>
    <rect x="36" y="498" width="316" height="35" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="515" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="55" cy="524" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="72" y="520" font-size="14" fill="#323232">1 passenger</text>
    <text x="197" y="520" font-size="14" fill="#323232">Economy</text>
    <polyline points="330,513 335,518 340,513" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- options -->
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif">
    <text x="20" y="587" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Flight preferences</text>
    <text x="20" y="610" font-size="13" fill="#949499">Choose your preferred flight options</text>

    <rect x="20" y="626" width="166" height="52" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="652" r="15" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <line x1="38" y1="652" x2="54" y2="652" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="49,647 54,652 49,657" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="69" y="649" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Direct flights</text>
    <text x="69" y="666" font-size="11" fill="#949499">Save time</text>

    <rect x="204" y="626" width="166" height="52" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="652" r="15" fill="#FFF1F1"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="652" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="230" y1="652" x2="230" y2="647" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="230" y1="652" x2="234" y2="655" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="253" y="649" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#323232">Flexible time</text>
    <text x="253" y="666" font-size="11" fill="#949499">More choices</text>
  </g>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="700" width="350" height="50" rx="12" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="195" y="731" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Search flights</text>
    <circle cx="293" cy="725" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="298" y1="730" x2="303" y2="735" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#EBEBEB"/>
  <g font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">
    <!-- home -->
    <polygon points="39,795 49,787 59,795 59,807 39,807" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="35,795 49,784 63,795" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="49" y="825" font-size="11" fill="#949499">Home</text>

    <!-- search active -->
    <circle cx="127" cy="796" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="134" y1="803" x2="141" y2="810" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="127" y="825" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Search</text>

    <!-- trips -->
    <rect x="195" y="789" width="19" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="199" y1="789" x2="199" y2="785" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="210" y1="789" x2="210" y2="785" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="794" x2="214" y2="794" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="204" y="825" font-size="11" fill="#949499">My trips</text>

    <!-- profile -->
    <circle cx="320" cy="793" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="805" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="320" y="825" font-size="11" fill="#949499">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
